name: Antipa Minerals Limited
summary: Antipa Minerals Limited engages in the mineral exploration business in Australia. It explores for gold, copper, silver, uranium, and tungsten deposits. The company holds 100% interests in its flagship, the Minyari Dome project covering an area of 144 square kilometers located in the Paterson Province. Antipa Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
